description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select a region based on your asset location. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Assets in the Chinese mainland and China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Assets outside China.

description.zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of this member.

description.zh:
视图类型。

- 0：当前阿里云账号视图。
- 1：企业下所有账号的视图。
description.en:
The view type.

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that are managed by your enterprise.

description.zh:
操作符使用场景类型。取值：
- 不传：默认场景
- AGGREGATE：聚合函数场景
description.en:
The scenario for the operator. Valid values:

- If you leave this parameter empty, the default scenario is used.

- AGGREGATE: The aggregate function scenario.

title.zh: 获取自定义规则操作符列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem describe-operators --scene-type AGGREGATE --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
